verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's core product does run background automation once configured — continuous transaction sync, nexus tracking, and autonomous filing across jurisdictions (kintsugi-docs-1, kintsugi-docs-3, kintsugi-docs-15) — but this is built-in SaaS automation, not something an AI-native user configures via agents or triggers. The only AI-facing feature, the MCP server, is scoped to serving API docs/code examples to coding assistants, not to setting up or running autonomous background automations (kintsugi-docs-6, kintsugi-docs-18). Missing for 10: evidence of user-configurable agentic workflows/triggers, scheduling or webhook-driven automation setup, and any AI-agent capability beyond documentation lookup.
